hint: The degree is the BIGGEST exponent on $x$.

hints.text: The degree is the BIGGEST exponent on $x$.
The exponents here are $3$, $1$, and $0$. Which is largest?

explanation: Look at every power of $x$: $x^3$, $x$, and the plain number $7$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Why the biggest one wins
steps: Plug in a huge number like $x = 100$.
The biggest exponent bosses the whole graph around, so it names the degree.
